thread:
alex: FYI starting shadow shift with @mira — I'll be primary for the first hour. Mira is shadowing and will take notes. ping if anything pages.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — INC-2026-03 Severity: P2. Endpoint: /v1/generate returning 503s for some requests. Paging primary: alex. Paging secondary: mira. Tags: us-east-1, rolling-deploy.

alex: Ack. I'm on it.

mira: here and watching. Alex how do you want me to escalate if this looks like a deploy problem?

alex: if error_rate > 2% for >5m or >5 customers affected, escalate to jamal + eng-runtime. Otherwise follow runbook and note steps.

oncall-bot: METRIC SNAPSHOT @1783456802 -> error_rate=2.8% (5m), p50 latency up 40ms, region=us-east-1.

alex: looks like the deploy that started 6m ago. First step: check deploy-bot status and failed pods.

deploy-bot: `deploy status ri-runtime-2026-3` -> rolling, updated=10/12, failed=2. See logs: https://internal/logs/deploy/ri-runtime-2026-3

mira: running `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=ri-runtime` now. Seeing CrashLoopBackOff on two new replicas. grabbing logs.

jamal: I'm available. if it's deploy/replica related we should consider rollback to r-2026-02 to restore capacity quickly.

alex: agreed. Mira — follow runbook page "runtime-503s" rollback steps (link: https://runbooks/internal/runtime-503s). I will initiate rollback if pods don't recover in 2 minutes.

mira: copying steps: 1) verify failed replicas 2) capture logs `kubectl logs --previous` 3) scale down new replicaset if unhealthy 4) promote previous replicaset. Executing step 1 and 2 now.

mira: logs show OOMKilled in new binary path and immediate 503s from nginx proxy. attaching snippet: ```
E0421 12:34:56 pod/ri-runtime-xyz: OOMKilled at alloc
stack: ...
``` 

alex: that's consistent with a bad memory config in the recent image. Initiating rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ri-runtime -n prod --to-revision=2026-02`

oncall-bot: ACTION: Pager acknowledged by alex at 1783456810

deploy-bot: rollback started -> replicaset r-2026-02 promoted. Monitor pod readiness.

mira: pods are coming up. new pods show Ready. Rechecking error rate.

oncall-bot: METRIC UPDATE @1783456835 -> error_rate=0.4% (1m), p50 latency normal.

alex: error rate back to baseline. Marking incident resolved per runbook: criteria met (errors <1% and traffic stable).

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — INC-2026-03 resolved by alex at 1783456845. Auto-post: please file follow-up (RCA) and tag eng-runtime.

jamal: good run. For shadowing notes: Mira — you handled runbook steps, captured logs, and coordinated rollback. Two quick onboarding items: 1) practice `kubectl rollout undo` and 2) know where to find the deployment logs link (deploy-bot).

alex: Agreed. Mira — can you open a GH issue with a short postmortem and checklist for reproducing in staging? assign to jamal for full RCA.

mira: opened https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/issues/234 with initial notes and links to logs. I'll add a short primer to the onboarding doc.

kelly: I've updated the new-hire on-call checklist: "shadow 2 incidents within 2 weeks, read 'deployment rollbacks' runbook, verify mobile PagerDuty notifications." Added Mira as completed for first shadow.

mira: Quick feedback — an annotated, step-by-step runbook in the console with screenshots would make onboarding much clearer. The inline rollback command helped.

alex: Good feedback. I'll add annotated screenshots to the runbook and schedule a 30m runbook walkthrough with jamal. Handoff notes: primary covered until 10:30 UTC, secondary is mira. No coverage gaps in next 2 hours. RCA owner: jamal. Next steps for onboarding: Mira to shadow two more incidents and practice rollback in staging. Thanks everyone — nice teamwork :tada:
